reader.requirement: At --std 85, an OPEN of an indexed file in any mode must neither make a record available nor release the record area: after OPEN INPUT/I-O the first READ delivers the first record, a sequential-access REWRITE/DELETE straight after OPEN I-O finds no READ (43), and OPEN OUTPUT/EXTEND followed by CLOSE adds no record. The witness is a sequential-organization program only.

edition-consulted.switches: bakes --std (85) into each connector's registration (FileConnector.Edition); no rule of this case reads it except the gates listed
file sharing facility off at 85 (no Table 19 arbitration, no '61'); not an outcome of this rule in one run unit

reader.edition-search: grep 'Edition|DialectBehavior' over KeyedConnector.OpenCore, FileConnector.OpenOnceEntered and SequentialIoEmitter.EmitOpen: OpenCore resets the position and attaches the store with no edition test; the only reads are registration and the sharing-facility lock
reader.witnesses-cover: part: l1_open_no_first_record exercises a SEQUENTIAL file; the indexed organization (this rule's module) and the I-O mode are not exercised (probed here)

probes.printed: record area K005EEEE then OPEN OUTPUT=00, CLOSE, READ at end 10 (nothing released); OPEN EXTEND with K009ZZZZ in the area then CLOSE adds nothing; OPEN INPUT then READ: K001AAAA, K002BBBB, at end 10; OPEN I-O then REWRITE=43, DELETE=43, READ=K001AAAA; dynamic OPEN I-O then READ NEXT=K001BBBB
probes.expected: OPEN obtains no record (the first READ gives the first record; REWRITE/DELETE before a READ is IX.1.3.4's 43) and releases none (file unchanged)

citations.check: OK  §1985:IX.4.4.4 GR6  (4.4.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR6  ["Execution of the OPEN statement does not obtain or release the first data record"]
OK  §1985:IX.1.3.4  (1.3.4 I-O Status)  the text is in the clause; it lies in GRL2.5c  ["was not a successfully executed READ statement"]

reader.notes: The indexed OPEN only positions (FpiValid, positioner 'O') and attaches the store; no record is read into the area or written from it. Probed across OUTPUT, EXTEND, INPUT and I-O.

refuter.evidence: Probe q2misc-001: record area set to ZZZZYYYY, OPEN INPUT (sequential access) and OPEN I-O (dynamic) leave the area ZZZZYYYY (A-OPEN/A-OPENIO), so OPEN loads no record into the area; reader's p3noobtain covers release (OUTPUT/EXTEND add nothing) and the 43 after OPEN I-O. cite: OK §1985:IX.4.4.4 GR6 [does not obtain or release the first data record].
